args.description: Seamless near-black blue-green weathered ruined marine stone background tile. Sparse tide-mark seams and broad quiet slabs. Dark #0D1B23 #19303A #294750 palette, extremely restrained highlights. No frame, no central object, no decoration, no text. Match Dungeon Matcher crisp native pixel-art: no anti-aliasing, gradients, blur or noisy individual speckles. Top-left light.

style_image.usage_description: Pixel density, clean outline and broad shading only; environmental/UI asset described, no character.
